title: The Biggest Pilot Shortage Isn't in North America
hook: Airlines need 649,000 new pilots, but demand peaks elsewhere.
closing: More aircraft mean training enough pilots becomes part of keeping flights available.
question: Would you train as a pilot?

segments.say: Airlines need 649,000 new pilots. That workforce gap reaches far beyond the crews flying today.
Eurasia needs 143,000 pilots. Its demand tops both China and North America.
The commercial fleet is projected to reach 48,600 aircraft. More jets create more cockpits that need trained crews.
